For Ethernet, you typically connect VP to a positive supply (e.g., 3.3V) and VN to GND. If VP is floating, the diode to VP is open, so positive ESD will forward bias the diode to VP, but since VP is floating, it will just charge up and not clamp. So the protection is compromised.
